newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested, compared to Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest mostly light. Offerings were light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
On a carcass basis (weight only) Compared Thursdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers not well established.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1250 lbs few 105.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 llbs no sales Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
